//maplibre-gl: maplibre-gl is PINNED (no caret) ON PURPOSE. maplibre-gl 6.x is ESM-only and OSD 2.19's build toolchain (webpack 4) cannot resolve/parse it, so we ship two hand-generated, version-locked artifacts that MUST be regenerated on any maplibre bump: (A) public/vendor/maplibre-gl.bundle.js — a CJS bundle for the webpack-4 build, remapped in via the `browser` field below and Jest's moduleNameMapper. Regenerate with: npx esbuild node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2018 --supported:bigint=true --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=public/vendor/maplibre-gl.bundle.js. (B) public/assets/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs + maplibre-gl-shared.mjs — the strict-CSP worker, copied verbatim from node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/ and served same-origin via setWorkerUrl (public/plugin.tsx). All three files MUST match this exact library version. DO NOT accept a bot/dependabot bump on its own: an upgrade must change both maplibre-gl versions here, regenerate (A), recopy (B), and re-test the OSD 2.19 build + strict-CSP runtime.
